description: Keyword search inside one public Telegram channel, using the channel's own preview search: matching posts with id, text, view count text and date (about 20 per page). It cannot search across all of Telegram; private chats and groups are not searchable here. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

channel.description: Public channel username without @ (5-32 letters, digits or _)

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (2-100 characters)
